description: Operator-facing surface and documentation: the dashboard fleet overview + per-agent drill-down (standalone unchanged), the config/data-path gitignoring, the ecosystem config, and the README/.env.example documenting all three modes, the protocol, the new REST endpoints, token rotation/revocation + security guidance, TLS/insecure, and the alias file — plus the end-to-end hub-and-spoke smoke run. Depends on FEAT-004 (the server REST + WS relay the dashboard consumes). Covers plan.md items 21 and 23 and the end-to-end smoke. Maps to design sections 5 (dashboard) and 8 items 21-22, FR-6/FR-10 with AC-37, AC-57/58.
steps: Edit public/js/api.js: add agent methods (listAgents, getAgent, agentProcesses, agentMetrics, agentLogs, agentControl, setAlias) and refactor the existing process methods to accept an OPTIONAL agentId that selects the base path (/api/agents/:id/... vs /api/processes/...). Standalone call sites pass no agentId and are unchanged.
Edit public/js/ws.js: logSubscribe accepts an optional agentId passed straight through into the log:subscribe frame; resubscribe preserves it. With no agentId the frame is byte-identical to today.

Create public/js/views/agents.js: a fleet overview rendering agent cards (alias-or-id, online badge, host/platform, process count, pm2-connected badge) with inline alias edit calling PUT /api/agents/:id/alias and the real id shown on hover/detail (AC-37). Selecting an agent drills into the existing overview/detail views parameterized by agentId.

Edit public/js/app.js, public/js/views/overview.js, public/js/views/detail.js, and public/index.html: discover mode from GET /api/system/health (now carries `mode`); gate all agent UI behind mode==='server'; parameterize overview/detail by an optional agentId so the per-agent process grid, control buttons, metrics, and log tail reuse the SAME components with only the base path changed. Standalone (mode absent/standalone) renders byte-identical to today.
Edit .gitignore: add the data paths config/agent-id and config/agent-aliases.json so the persisted agent ID suffix and alias map are never committed.

Edit ecosystem.config.cjs: document the new env vars grouped by mode (MODE, and the agent vars SERVER_URL/AGENT_TOKEN/AGENT_NAME/AGENT_ID_FILE/AGENT_WS_PATH/TLS_INSECURE, and the server vars AGENT_TOKENS/ALIAS_STORE_FILE/AGENT_WS_PATH/TLS_CERT_FILE/TLS_KEY_FILE) as commented examples, consistent with the existing env block style.

Edit README.md and .env.example: document the three run modes with an example config per mode, the agent-token setup + rotation/revocation (multiple valid tokens) + security guidance, the TLS/insecure toggle, the alias persistence file, the protocol summary (versioned JSON discriminated union over the agent<->server WS), the new REST endpoints under /api/agents, and the server-mode /logs live-ring semantics vs. the standalone file tail. .env.example lists every new variable with safe defaults and clear insecure-toggle warnings.

Run the end-to-end hub-and-spoke smoke described in design section 9: start one server (MODE=server, a token, native TLS off), start one agent (MODE=agent, SERVER_URL=ws://localhost:PORT, matching token) against a real local PM2 with a demo process; confirm the agent appears online in GET /api/agents, a control command round-trips, live logs stream in the dashboard drill-down, an alias set persists across a server restart, and MODE unset still serves the identical standalone dashboard. Record the outcome in findings. If a real PM2 daemon is unavailable in the environment, state that clearly and rely on the FEAT-004 in-process integration test as the automated substitute.
acceptance_criteria: `npm run build` compiles clean and `npm test` passes the full suite (all preserved + new tests), confirming no regression from the dashboard/doc/config changes.
The standalone dashboard is byte-for-byte behaviorally identical to today (no agent concepts when mode is standalone).
In server mode the dashboard shows a fleet overview and drills into per-agent views reusing the existing components, with inline alias editing showing the real id on hover (AC-37).

README.md and .env.example document all three modes with an example per mode, token rotation/revocation + security guidance, TLS/insecure, the alias file, the protocol, and the new REST endpoints (FR-10).

The end-to-end smoke outcome is recorded (agent online, control round-trip, live logs, alias persists across restart, standalone unchanged) or, if a real PM2 daemon is unavailable, that limitation is stated with the integration test as the substitute.
